summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Mailing Lists feature. Backend API: 17/17 tests passed. Frontend UI: All core features working. Fixed 1 bug in Import modal (empty SelectItem value).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - SelectItem with empty string value caused runtime error when selecting 'From Contacts' or 'From Leads' import source
Minor UI issue - After deleting a list, the right panel still shows the deleted list's subscribers until page refresh. The selectedList state should be cleared when the list is deleted.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/mailing-lists - List all mailing lists
Backend: POST /api/mailing-lists - Create new mailing list
Backend: GET /api/mailing-lists/{id} - Get single list with subscribers
Frontend: Navigate to Mailing Lists via sidebar
Frontend: Create new mailing list with name, description, category
Frontend: Add subscriber manually to list
Frontend: Export list as CSV file
Frontend: Import subscribers from contacts (after fix)
Frontend: Delete mailing list via dropdown menu
Frontend: Stats cards update correctly after CRUD operations
action_items: Minor: Clear selectedList state when a list is deleted to avoid showing stale data in the right panel
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MailingListsPage.jsx lines 615 and 631 had SelectItem with empty string value which is not allowed in Radix UI Select. Changed to use 'all' value and convert back to empty string in onValueChange handler.
seed_data_creation: Test lists created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mailing Lists feature is fully functional. Backend API endpoints all working. Frontend UI working with one minor issue (selectedList state not cleared after delete). Import modal bug was fixed by changing empty string SelectItem values to 'all' value.
